The controller is CSI-agnostic, meaning it works with any CSI driver that supports the snapshot API, providing a standardized way to handle persistent volume snapshots in Kubernetes clusters.

securityContext:
  fsGroup: 1000
  runAsUser: 1000
  runAsGroup: 1000
  runAsNonRoot: true

set -eux

if [ -z "$(ls -A ${OBSIDIAN_PATH})" ]; then
  echo "[INFO] Directory is empty. Cloning repository..."
  git clone https://${GIT_USER}:${GIT_TOKEN}@${GIT_URL} ${OBSIDIAN_PATH}
  echo "[INFO] Clone completed."
else
  echo "[WARN] Directory not empty. Skipping clone."
fi

cd ${OBSIDIAN_PATH}
while true; do
  echo "[INFO] Pulling changes from remote repository..."
  git pull
  echo "[INFO] Pull completed. Sleeping for ${PULL_INTERVAL} seconds..."
  sleep ${PULL_INTERVAL}
done

- name: KEYCLOAK_ADMIN

      key: password
- name: KC_DB_PASSWORD
